mapper.select: SELECT id FROM judge_tasks WHERE status = 'QUEUED' ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE judge_tasks SET status = 'ASSIGNED', worker_id = #{workerId}, attempts = attempts + 1, lease_expires_at = #{leaseUntil}, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'QUEUED'
UPDATE judge_tasks SET status = 'QUEUED', worker_id = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, last_error = 'lease expired', updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 'ASSIGNED'
mapper.select: SELECT submission_id FROM judge_tasks WHERE id = #{taskId}
